eu_edo_cdi.band: cdinx, Combined Drought Indicator class per ten-day period (uint8, 29 dekads in 2026 file, 1200 × 1824 grid, extent -25..51 E, 22..72 N)
eu_edo_cdi.unit: class code: 0 no drought, 1 watch, 2 warning, 3 alert, 4 recovery, 5 temporary soil-moisture recovery, 6 temporary vegetation recovery, 7 no data inside LISFLOOD domain, 8 outside domain (fill)
